notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms.us list (Google map revised 2016) places a tower here. The Eastern U.S. Lookouts Georgia directory and the NHLR Georgia index have no Richwood tower. The directory does list a 'WALTON' tower in Dooly County with no operator or detail. The sources do not say whether it is this structure, so the story makes no link. The list's elevation (363) has no unit stated; the brief's 110.6 m assumes feet. The list's coordinates (32.03313, -83.79330) are about 1.2 km from the Wikipedia coordinates for the community (32.04194, -83.78639); this is my own calculation, not a source's. The community sentences come from Wikipedia and the New Georgia Encyclopedia and describe the place, not the tower. The brief's register numbers (BLL US 41114, GFC US 330) match the list's codes. Two web searches and a few page reads found no construction, staffing or site-status detail. The story is about 110 words, short because the evidence is thin.
